{{short description|Austrian mathematician}}
[[File:Paule Peter.jpg|thumb|Peter Paule, 2010]]
'''Peter Paule''' is an [[Austrians|Austrian]] mathematician who works in [[symbolic computation]] and its connections to [[combinatorics]], [[number theory]], and [[special functions]]. Since 1990 he has held a faculty position at the [[Research Institute for Symbolic Computation]] of the [[Johannes Kepler University of Linz]], and since 2009 he has directed the Institute.<ref name="cv">[http://www.risc.jku.at/people/ppaule/vitae.shtml Curriculum vitae], retrieved 2015-01-15.</ref>

Paule earned his doctorate from the [[University of Vienna]] in 1982 under the supervision of Johann Cigler,<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=19765}}</ref> and earned a [[habilitation]] from Johannes Kepler University in 1996.<ref name="cv"/> He is a member of the [[Academia Europaea]],<ref>[http://www.ae-info.org/ae/User/Paule_Peter Academia Europaea member profile], retrieved 2015-01-15.</ref> and in 2013 he was elected as a [[fellow]] of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |date=2018-08-25 }}, retrieved 2015-01-15.</ref>
